text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Tokai Teio!
She conquers the Nippon Derby!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text: She has proven on this grand stage that her talent and brilliance are the real deal!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
I'm gonna keep this momentum going for the next one too!
See you all at the Kikuka Sho!!!!
(UOOOOOOOOH!)

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Fufun, not bad, Teio.
But Turbo should've been the real winner.

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Yes, Turbo didn't lose to Teio.
She lost to this long straightaway.

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Next time, I'm gonna beat Teio!
And while I'm at it, I'll beat Tokyo too!!
choice_data_list: The next Triple Crown race is at Kyoto, though?

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text: Eeeek, then we won't stand a chance against Tokyo?!

Let's save my revenge on Tokyo Racecourse...
for sometime in the future.
And after the Winning Live concluded...

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Hm, Trainer. Someone's coming.
Is that...?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Out of the way...! Sorry, move!
Please, get out of the way!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Let me through, please!

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text: How rare to see the President get so flustered. Did something happen?

A chill crept down my spine. I had a bad feeling.
And then—

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text: Eeeeh, Tokai Teio got a fracture~ !?

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: How could this be... Not Teio...

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
She might not even be able to run in the Kikuka-sho...?
You've gotta be kidding me...

That shocking news sent massive ripples through
not just Tracen Academy, but society as a whole.
"If Tokai Teio is absent this autumn, the entire landscape of the Classic Triple Crown will shift drastically, but..."

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Turbo, Trainer-san.
I have an update... about Teio.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
"It sounds like she's not giving up on entering the Kikuka-sho.
We don't know if she can make it, but both she and her team are going to do their best."

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
I see, I see.
Well...

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text: Turbo knew it all along, though!!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Huh, you look awfully confident!?

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
"Come on, that's Tokai Teio we're talking about.
There's no way a broken bone is gonna make
her give up."

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
More importantly, Nature!
Turbo and the gang gotta get to work!
Right, Trainer?

Summer training camp season is approaching.
On top of that, our target race,
the Radio NIKKEI Sho, is drawing near.

"Of course I'm concerned about our rivals, but we can't afford
to get entirely caught up in that."

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
You're right... There's nothing we can do for Teio.
All we can do is...

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
"All that matters is getting stronger! Why am I worrying
about Teio when she's already so far ahead of me!?"

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: All right, let's do it, Turbo!

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Yeah! Turbo and the gang just gotta
burst forward with all our might toward autumn!

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text: Trainer, Nature, both of you believe in Turbo and follow my lead!

Twin Turbo remained endlessly positive.
Undeterred by Tokai Teio's setback,
she keeps barreling down her own path.
